newsitem.title: CHINA: Johnson & Johnson opens Shanghai sutures plant.
newsitem.headline: Johnson & Johnson opens Shanghai sutures plant.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson opened a $16 million factory in a Shanghai suburb to produce high-quality silk sutures, the company said in a statement.
It will eventually manufacture over 80 million metres of silk annually, for sale to the Chinese market and the company's affiliates in Europe and the Asia-Pacific region, the statement said.
Johnson & Johnson has five legal entities in China, including three joint ventures, two wholly-owned ventures and a total of seven business units, it said but gave no more details.
